ambiguities.clarification_question: What is the exact definition of '30 minutes' in this context?

acceptance_criteria.description: The reset link expires 30 minutes after it is sent.
acceptance_criteria.given: A user requests a password reset and receives a link via email.
acceptance_criteria.when: The user clicks the reset link within 30 minutes of receiving it.
acceptance_criteria.then: The link is no longer valid and the user must request a new link to reset their password.

acceptance_criteria.description: The new password must be between 8 and 64 characters.
acceptance_criteria.given: A user requests a password reset and receives a link via email.
acceptance_criteria.when: The user clicks the reset link and enters a new password within the allowed length.
acceptance_criteria.then: The new password is applied to the user's account and the old password is invalidated.

acceptance_criteria.description: The new password must contain at least 1 digit.
acceptance_criteria.given: A user requests a password reset and receives a link via email.
acceptance_criteria.when: The user clicks the reset link and enters a new password with at least one digit.
acceptance_criteria.then: The new password is applied to the user's account and the old password is invalidated.

acceptance_criteria.description: A user can request at most 3 reset emails per hour.
acceptance_criteria.given: A user requests a password reset and receives a link via email.
acceptance_criteria.when: The user requests a password reset within the allowed time frame and receives 3 reset emails.
acceptance_criteria.then: The user is prompted to wait an hour before requesting another password reset.

acceptance_criteria.description: The new password must not equal the current password.
acceptance_criteria.given: A user requests a password reset and receives a link via email.
acceptance_criteria.when: The user clicks the reset link and enters a new password that is the same as the current password.
acceptance_criteria.then: The user is prompted to enter a new password that is different from the current one.

test_scenarios.title: Valid password reset link expires within 30 minutes
test_steps: A user requests a password reset and receives a link via email.
The user clicks the reset link within 30 minutes of receiving it.
test_scenarios.expected_result: The link is no longer valid and the user must request a new link to reset their password.

test_scenarios.title: Valid password reset with new password between 8 and 64 characters
test_steps: A user requests a password reset and receives a link via email.
The user clicks the reset link and enters a new password within the allowed length.
test_scenarios.expected_result: The new password is applied to the user's account and the old password is invalidated.

test_scenarios.title: Valid password reset with new password containing at least 1 digit
test_steps: A user requests a password reset and receives a link via email.
The user clicks the reset link and enters a new password with at least one digit.
test_scenarios.expected_result: The new password is applied to the user's account and the old password is invalidated.

test_scenarios.title: Valid password reset with new password within 3 reset emails per hour limit
test_steps: A user requests a password reset and receives a link via email.
The user clicks the reset link and enters a new password within the allowed time frame.
test_scenarios.expected_result: The user is prompted to wait an hour before requesting another password reset.

test_scenarios.title: Valid password reset with new password not equal to current password
test_steps: A user requests a password reset and receives a link via email.
The user clicks the reset link and enters a new password that is different from the current one.
test_scenarios.expected_result: The new password is applied to the user's account and the old password is invalidated.

test_scenarios.title: Invalid password length (too short)
test_steps: A user requests a password reset and receives a link via email.
The user clicks the reset link and enters a new password with fewer than 8 characters.
test_scenarios.expected_result: The new password is not applied to the user's account and the old password is not invalidated.

test_scenarios.title: Invalid password contains no digits
test_steps: A user requests a password reset and receives a link via email.
The user clicks the reset link and enters a new password without any digits.
test_scenarios.expected_result: The new password is not applied to the user's account and the old password is not invalidated.

test_scenarios.title: Invalid new password for password reset
test_steps: A user requests a password reset and receives a link via email.
The user clicks the reset link and enters a new password that is the same as the current password.
test_scenarios.expected_result: The user is prompted to enter a new password that is different from the current one.

test_scenarios.title: Exceeds reset email limit within 1 hour
test_steps: A user requests a password reset and receives a link via email.
The user clicks the reset link and enters a new password within 1 hour of receiving the link, triggering the reset email limit.
test_scenarios.expected_result: The user is prompted to wait an hour before requesting another password reset.
